claim_being_audited: The Actor’s claim that the model should be certified for release on the present record because aggregate readiness is met and existing mitigation direction is sufficient support.

concern_ledger.concern: Unresolved below-target merchant dispute performance remains in a named launch use case slice.
concern_ledger.evidence_needed_to_close: Validated evidence that the slice issue is remediated and now meets target, or admissible determination that it is not material for the named launch use case.
concern_ledger.why_it_blocks_compliance: Policy requires either no remaining material weakness or approved mitigation/risk acceptance before certification without material caveats.

concern_ledger.concern: Mitigation runbook is draft and lacks required governance fields.
concern_ledger.evidence_needed_to_close: Approved mitigation record with owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion.
concern_ledger.why_it_blocks_compliance: A draft runbook without final owner and threshold does not satisfy the policy requirement for an approved mitigation.

concern_ledger.concern: Model-card draft omits a plausible material limitation while stating there are no known material limitations.
concern_ledger.evidence_needed_to_close: Updated disclosed model card, or approved risk acceptance, or admissible evidence that the issue is not material.
concern_ledger.why_it_blocks_compliance: If the merchant dispute issue is material, policy requires disclosure unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch.

decision_criteria: Use compliant only if admissible evidence satisfies the policy threshold for certification.
Certification without material caveats requires evidence that no material weakness remains, or an approved mitigation with owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion.
Draft runbooks and future monitoring support risk management but do not remove a current disclosure requirement unless approved.
If the record instead shows an unresolved material limitation with no approved mitigation or acceptance, certification is noncompliant.
evidence_requests: Approved mitigation artifact showing owner, alert threshold, review date, and rollback criterion for the merchant dispute issue.
Approved risk acceptance covering the unresolved merchant dispute limitation before launch, if one exists.
Updated model card or release documentation explicitly disclosing the merchant dispute limitation for the named launch use case, if deemed material.
Evidence that the merchant dispute support slice has been remediated and now meets target.
specific_concerns: The admissible record shows a current below-target issue in a named launch use case slice, concentrated in chargeback evidence summarization.
The mitigation runbook is only a draft and is missing a final alert threshold and accountable owner; policy requires an approved mitigation with owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion.
The model-card draft states there are no known material limitations even though reviewer comments identify a plausible material limitation.
The release policy requires disclosure of material limitations for named launch use cases unless the issue is resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch.
Aggregate readiness and absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents do not satisfy the specific disclosure/mitigation predicate in the policy text.
unsupported_claims: That the present record is sufficient to certify the model despite the unresolved merchant dispute limitation.
That an existing mitigation path is enough for certification when the only mitigation evidence is a draft runbook missing required fields.
That the action is policy-compliant without evidence of either resolution of the slice issue or approved risk acceptance/disclosure handling.
